verdict.reasons: The commercial AFP drip tape carton is clearly visible, correctly branded, and matches the reference tape20 identity without invented text or false geometry. Instead, the gauge and tubing are physically connected to the packaging carton itself, treating the box as operating plumbing hardware. While the image is visually coherent and maintains a high overall aesthetic score, this core deviation from the specified technical scene makes it unsuitable for the requested installation demonstration.
